## 4. Architectural Case Studies & Production Systems

### System 1: Scalable Digital Banking Backend Platform
- **Category**: Banking Platform / Microservices
- **Throughput**: Multi-million financial transactions/day
- **Availability**: 99.99% high availability
- **Architectural Highlights**:
  - Decomposed legacy monolithic endpoints into modular Spring Boot microservices orchestrated via Kubernetes pods.
  - Implemented reactive WebClient patterns with circuit breakers (Resilience4j) and fallback mechanisms to ensure 99.99% availability during downstream gateway latency spikes.
  - Standardized multi-tenant data validation rules across account creation and customer verification pipelines.
  - Integrated Splunk and Kibana APM tracing with correlation IDs for end-to-end transaction observability and rapid root-cause analysis.
- **Key Outcomes**:
  - Sub-second response times for customer onboarding and eligibility evaluations.
  - Eliminated single points of failure across critical financial transaction workflows.
  - Full compliance with OWASP and banking data protection benchmarks.

### System 2: Optimized Kafka Event Processing Hub
- **Category**: Event Streaming & Distributed Messaging
- **Highlights**:
  - Designed header-based event routing to eliminate unnecessary deserialization of non-target messages, slashing CPU utilization on downstream consumer pods.
  - Tuned partition allocation strategies and consumer concurrency thresholds to maximize I/O throughput.
  - Implemented resilient dead-letter-queue (DLQ) automated replay patterns with exponential backoff for transient network glitches.
  - Built telemetry metrics dashboards in Kibana and Splunk tracking producer rate, lag delta, and listener health.
- **Key Outcomes**:
  - Reduced consumer lag to near-zero (~90% lag reduction) even during peak transaction volume bursts.
  - Drastically improved message traceability across microservice boundaries using unified event headers.

### System 3: Enterprise Shared Platform Libraries & Reusable SDKs
- **Category**: Enterprise SDK / Platform Engineering
- **Adoption**: 20+ product development teams
- **Highlights**:
  - Architected standardized WebClient client adapters with built-in retry policies, SSL handshakes, and metric logging interceptors.
  - Created plug-and-play validation starter dependencies providing customizable bean validation for complex financial payloads.
  - Streamlined CI/CD dependency management with Maven multi-module archetypes and version governance.
- **Key Outcomes**:
  - Accelerated time-to-market for new microservice features by 35% across 20+ teams.
  - Standardized error handling payloads, preventing security leakage and inconsistencies across client-facing apps.

## 5. Intellectual Property & Granted Patents

### Patent 1: Fall Prevention System
- **Patent Number**: Patent No. 202011012664
- **Status**: Published / Granted
- **Domain**: IoT, Embedded Sensors & Autonomous Safety Systems
- **Official Portal**: Indian Patent Office (IP India)
- **Summary**:
  An intelligent, sensor-driven safety system designed to detect imminent loss of balance and body posture anomalies in real time, triggering proactive mechanical and alerting mechanisms to prevent human injury before impact occurs.
- **Key Innovations**:
  - Real-time sensor fusion analyzing multi-axis acceleration and gyro telemetry.
  - Predictive anomaly detection algorithms operating with ultra-low latency.
  - Rapid-response actuation framework for proactive physical stabilization.

### Patent 2: Surveillance and Alert System
- **Patent Number**: Patent No. 202111014541
- **Status**: Published / Granted
- **Domain**: Automated Surveillance, Computer Vision & Edge Alerting
- **Official Portal**: Indian Patent Office (IP India)
- **Summary**:
  A smart surveillance architecture incorporating edge intelligence, automated security threat detection, and real-time notification dispatching to designated response units upon perimeter breaches or suspicious activity.
- **Key Innovations**:
  - Multi-zone threat analysis with automated event classification.
  - Edge-to-cloud telemetry sync minimizing false-positive emergency alerts.
  - Instantaneous multi-channel dispatch protocol (audio visual, cellular, webhook triggers).

## 6. Personal Projects & Documentation Guides

### Project 1: Expenso — 100% Offline Android Finance Architecture
- **Documentation**: https://maurihimanshu.github.io/#docs?topic=expenso-android
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.offline.expenso
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/maurihimanshu/expenso-docs
- **Architecture**:
  - Clean Architecture separating Presentation (MVVM LiveData), Domain (Use Cases), and Data (SQLCipher Encrypted Room).
  - Multi-layer security with hardware-backed Android Keystore AES-256-GCM and full database encryption.
  - BiometricPrompt authentication and PIN fallback with root/tamper detection.
  - 100% offline-first operation with local encrypted backup/restore and zero cloud telemetry.

### Project 2: AI Work Assistant — Desktop Productivity & Local ML
- **Documentation**: https://maurihimanshu.github.io/#docs?topic=ai-work-assistant
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/maurihimanshu/ai_work_assistant
- **Architecture**:
  - Event-driven background activity monitor capturing application window focus, input velocity, and session state.
  - Offline machine learning models (Scikit-Learn) for automated activity classification and focus scoring without cloud API dependencies.
  - Secured local encrypted storage (SQLite + AES) for zero-leakage privacy.
  - Modular desktop GUI built with PyQt6 providing interactive productivity heatmaps.

### Project 3: Reliable Air-Gapped QR File Transfer Protocol
- **Documentation**: https://maurihimanshu.github.io/#docs?topic=qr-file-transfer
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/maurihimanshu/Reliable-QR-File-Transfer
- **Architecture**:
  - Optical packet protocol wrapping payloads into sequenced JSON frames (`['RQFT', 1, frameType, transferId, frame]`).
  - Multi-round repeated chunk streaming directly overcoming frame drops in camera receivers.
  - End-to-end byte stream compression and SHA-256 cryptographic manifest verification before reassembly.
  - Zero-dependency static web interface in React & TypeScript deployable in air-gapped environments.
